deals.sourceText: With promo code "SAVE20TECH", this certified refurbished Creality K2 Combo 3D printer drops to $327 at eBay. That's nearly half the price you'd pay for this same model in new condition elsewhere, so it's a great price if you don't mind a refurb. It comes direct from Creality with a 2-year warranty serviced by Allstate and 30-day free returns. The combo includes the CFS system for printing in up to 16 colors. Shipping is free and the coupon ends November 8. Buy Now at eBay Features Prints at speeds up to 600 mm/s Multi-color printing with up to 16 colors via the included CFS 0.4mm nozzle Certified refurbished by the manufacturer Two-year warranty included Free standard shipping and 30-day returns
